what: In a grid of photo cells of different sizes, cells change to the next photo one at a time in turn. The next image opens from the bottom of the cell upward (clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) → 0, 1.2s power2.out) and the picture inside moves in from 1.2x to 1x over 1.4s. The moment one cell starts to open, the next cell is scheduled after a random 1.8·2·2.2·2.4s (only the first cell .4s) so it continues without a break. The cell order follows each cell’s data-step number (a cell can appear twice)

options.delays: Candidate delays before the next cell (s, comma separated), default 1.8,2,2.2,2.4 — one picked at random
options.ease: Curve in the form ”0.25,1,0.5,1”, default power2.out

use:
…
— cell size and grid are in the consumer’s css

from.where: index.html .op-kv (hero nine photo slots — original kv: 8 steps, the first four return to the second section, the last four to the first)
